# example/helm-guard

An example community rule pack, used by the tests and as a template. It is not
shipped in the sensor.

| Rule | Verdict | When |
|---|---|---|
| `helm-uninstall` | ask | `helm uninstall` or `helm delete` |
| `kubectl-drain` | ask | `kubectl drain` or `kubectl cordon` |

Use it from a policy once it is installed:

```yaml
extends: [example/helm-guard@^1]
```

schema: privometry.rulepack/v1
id: example/helm-guard
version: 1.0.0
title: Helm and node guard (example)
description: An example community pack. Asks before an agent uninstalls a Helm release or drains a Kubernetes node. Publishers copy this folder, change the publisher and name, and sign it with privometry packs sign.
maintainers:
  - { name: Example publisher, url: https://example.com }
license: Apache-2.0
min_sensor_version: 0.6.0
categories: [catastrophic]
default_fail_modes: { catastrophic: ask }
keywords: [kubernetes, helm, example]

schema: privometry.rules/v1
rules:
  - id: helm-uninstall
    description: Removing a Helm release deletes everything it installed.
    category: catastrophic
    when:
      action: shell_exec
      program: helm
      subcommand: [uninstall, delete]
    verdict: ask
    message: This removes a Helm release and everything it installed; confirm it.
  - id: kubectl-drain
    description: Draining or cordoning a node moves workloads off it.
    category: catastrophic
    when:
      action: shell_exec
      program: kubectl
      subcommand: [drain, cordon]
    verdict: ask
    message: This takes a Kubernetes node out of service; confirm it.
